transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net, my name's Sophie. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hi, I've been trying to log into my S-Net email for two days and it keeps saying wrong password, but I know it's right. I'm getting so annoyed with it.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That's annoying, especially when you're sure the password is right. Let's get you back in. Can you answer the security question on your account, please?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: My mum's maiden name is Hartley.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you, that's verified. So for two days you've been getting a wrong-password message on S-Net email, even though you're sure the password is correct. Is that right?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Are you logging in on the website, or in an email app on your phone?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: The app on my phone. The website does the same, I tried.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Did you change your password anywhere else recently, for example on the S-Net account page?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Oh. I did change my account password last week, actually.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That's very likely it. The email password and the account password became one and the same in our update last month, so the email now needs the new one. Could you try logging into the email with the password you set last week?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Okay. Trying on the website. Yes, I'm in.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Great. And in the app, you'll need to remove the account and add it again with the new password. Can you try that now?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Perfect. So your email works on both the website and the app now. Is that all sorted for you?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You're welcome. Thank you for choosing S-Net, have a good day.
